items.title: 15.5.1 Central Nervous System - Brain & Spinal Cord (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the brain and spinal cord (PDF 36-40).

blocks.text: CNS inter-neurons aur neuroglia se bana hai. Dimagh cranium (khopri) mein aur spinal cord vertebral column mein hai, aur dono teen hifazati jhilliyon, meninges, se dhake hain.

items: Dura mater: sab se bahari moti teh jo khopri aur vertebrae ke bilkul neeche hai aur jis mein bari khoon ki nalyan hain.
Arachnoid: patli doosri teh jo apne neeche ke cerebrospinal fluid aur dura mater ke khoon ke darmiyan rukawat hai.
Pia mater: bohat nazuk teesri teh jo dimagh aur spinal cord ki sateh se chipki hoti hai; is ki capillaries unhein ghiza deti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: bahar se andar meninges ki tahein: haddi, moti dura mater, patli arachnoid, cerebrospinal fluid wali jagah, nazuk pia mater, phir dimagh ya spinal cord. Daen: spinal cord ki tarash, white matter ka bayzavi hissa jis ke andar H-numa grey matter aur central canal; har taraf ganglion wali dorsal root aur ventral root mil kar spinal nerve banati hain. Note spinal nerves ke 31 jore ginta hai.
blocks.caption: Meninges aur spinal cord (Figures 15.9 aur 15.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teen meninges dimagh aur spinal cord ko dhakti hain: bari nalyon wali moti bahari dura mater, patli arachnoid jo apne neeche ke cerebrospinal fluid ko dura ke khoon se alag rakhti hai, aur sateh par nazuk pia mater jis ki capillaries tissue ko ghiza deti hain. Spinal cord mein tarteeb dimagh se ulti hai: grey matter (inter-neurons aur motor neurons ke cell bodies) andar ka H banata, white matter (myelin wale axons) bahar ka hissa, central canal ke gird jo chauthe ventricle se mila hua hai. Har spinal nerve dorsal root (sensory, cell bodies dorsal root ganglion mein) aur ventral root (motor) ke milne se banti hai. 31 jore hain: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral aur 1 coccygeal.

blocks.text: Aik ausat baligh ka dimagh taqreeban 1.4 kg (jism ke wazan ka taqreeban 2%) hota aur us mein taqreeban 100 arab inter-neurons hain, har aik hazaron doosron se synapses rakhta hai. Kitab dimagh ko Grade X ke forebrain, midbrain aur hindbrain ke bajaye nayi taqseem se bayan karti hai.

items: Cerebrum: sab se bara hissa, is ki bahari teh bohat tehdar. Aik gehri dararr (fissure) ise baen aur daen cerebral hemispheres mein baant'ti hai, jo dararr ki tah par corpus callosum, yaani axons ki patti, se jure hain. Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf se ehsas leta aur usi taraf ko motor hukm bhejta hai.

Brainstem, cerebrum ke neeche aur use spinal cord se jorta hai: midbrain nazar aur sunne ki maloomat aage bhejta aur reticular formation rakhta hai; pons cerebral hemispheres aur cerebellum ke darmiyan impulses le jata hai; medulla oblongata dil ki dharkan, saans aur doosre homeostatic kaamon ka relay aur control centre hai.

Diencephalon, brainstem ke oopar beech mein gehra: thalamus hissi maloomat cerebrum tak pohanchata; hypothalamus andaruni aaza ki sargarmiyan murattab karta, darja-e-hararat, bhook aur sairi, pyaas aur jazbat qaboo karta, aur pituitary gland ko chalata hai.

Cerebellum, cerebral hemispheres ke neeche aur peeche: white matter ke oopar kasi hui tehdar cortex; yeh muscles, tendons, jodon, aankhon aur kaanon se impulses leta, jism ki halat qaboo karta aur brainstem aur cerebral cortex ke saath tez harkatein murattab karta hai.

blocks.text: Limbic system thalamus ke dono taraf, cerebrum ke neeche, jure hue hisson ka group hai: hypothalamus, temporal lobes mein gehre do badam-numa amygdalae (mohabbat, nafrat, gussa, dar, ghazab aur jinsi ubhaar), aur hippocampus, amygdalae se peeche mure do seeng, jo maloomat ko thori der ki yaad se lambi yaad mein le jata hai. Thalamus ke do hisson ke milne ki jagah pineal gland melatonin banata hai jo neend ke andaz qaboo karta hai.

blocks.alt: Beech se kata hua dimagh, baen ki taraf rukh. Oopar bara, tehdar cerebrum; us ke neeche muri hui corpus callosum, thalamus aur us ke peeche pineal gland, hypothalamus aur neeche latakta pituitary, limbic system ke amygdala aur hippocampus, neeche spinal cord tak jate midbrain, pons aur medulla oblongata, aur peeche cerebellum.
blocks.caption: Insani dimagh ke bare hisse, limbic system ke saath (Figures 15.10 aur 15.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Cerebrum, sab se bara hissa, do hemispheres mein bata hai jo corpus callosum se jure hain. Diencephalon andar gehrai mein hai: thalamus hissi maloomat cerebrum tak pohanchata aur hypothalamus darja-e-hararat, bhook, pyaas aur jazbat qaboo karta aur pituitary ko chalata hai. Limbic system mein hypothalamus, amygdalae (jazbat) aur hippocampus (thori der ki yaad ko lambi yaad mein badalna) shamil hain. Brainstem (midbrain, pons, medulla oblongata) cerebrum ko spinal cord se jorta hai; medulla dil ki dharkan aur saans qaboo karta hai. Cerebellum muscles ke amal aur jism ki halat (posture) ko murattab karta hai.

blocks.caption: Har hemisphere ke lobes
rows: intizami kaam: zabt-e-nafs, mansooba bandi, dalil, mujarrad soch
hissi maloomat ka tajziya, jism ki position aur mahol ka ehsas, tawajjuh, harkat ka mansooba aur amal
nazar ki yaad rakhne ke liye hissi input, zaban samajhna, jazbat

blocks.text: Hemispheres par ubhar gyri hain, jinhein uthli nalyan (sulci) aur gehri dararein (fissures) alag karti hain. Tehdar bahari teh, cerebral cortex, inter-neurons se bhara grey matter hai. Is ke motor areas skeletal muscles ko impulses bhejte; sensory areas maloomat lete hain, temporal lobe ka auditory cortex awaz ki frequencies aur occipital lobe ka visual cortex aankhon ki maloomat sambhalta hai; association areas aala zehni kaam karte hain, kuch aik hi taraf, jaise zaban baen aur nazar-o-fasla ki salahiyat daen. Cortex ke neeche myelin wale axons ka white matter hisson ko jorta hai. Aik hemisphere ko nuqsan jism ki mukhalif taraf ehsas khatam aur falij kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Cerebrum ka baen pehlu, chaar lobes rangeen: aage frontal, us ke peeche oopar parietal, peeche occipital aur neeche temporal. Beech ki nali (central groove) ke bilkul aage surkh motor patti aur peeche neeli sensory patti; temporal lobe mein auditory cortex aur occipital lobe mein visual cortex nishan zada. Neeche cerebellum aur brainstem. Dabba har lobe ka kaam batata hai.
blocks.caption: Cerebrum ke chaar lobes aur us ke sensory, motor aur association areas (Figures 15.11 aur 15.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har cerebral hemisphere ke chaar lobes hain. Frontal lobe mansooba bandi, dalil, zabt-e-nafs aur mujarrad soch se; parietal lobe hawas, jism ki position aur tawajjuh se; temporal lobe yaad, zaban aur jazbat se; occipital lobe nazar se mutalliq hai. Tehdar grey cortex mein motor areas skeletal muscles ko hukm bhejte, sensory areas maloomat lete (temporal lobe mein auditory cortex, occipital lobe mein visual cortex), aur association areas aala zehni kaam karte hain. Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf ko qaboo karta hai.

blocks.text: Dimagh aur spinal cord khokhle hain, un mein mayi se bhare khane hain jinhein ventricles kehte hain jo cerebrospinal fluid banate aur chalate hain. Yeh chaar hain: cerebrum mein do bare lateral ventricles, diencephalon mein thalamus ke do hisson ke darmiyan teesra ventricle, aur cerebellum aur brainstem ke darmiyan chautha, jo spinal cord ki central canal se mila hai.

Spinal cord neurons ki aik taar hai jo medulla oblongata se reerh ki haddi mein neeche jati, vertebral column aur meninges se mehfooz; is ki motai 0.25 se 0.5 inch hai, cervical hisse (baazu aur dhar) aur lumbar hisse (taangein) mein zyada chauri. Is ka grey aur white matter dimagh ke ulat tarteeb mein hai: andar H ya titli-numa grey matter (inter-neurons aur motor neurons ke cell bodies, neuroglia, baghair myelin axons) central canal ke gird, aur bahar white matter (myelin wale axons). Yeh jism aur dimagh ke darmiyan maloomat ki shahrah hai.

blocks.prompt: Jo shakhs tawazun qaim na rakh sake us ke dimagh ka kaunsa hissa mutasir hoga, aur jis ki saans ki raftar bigar jaye us ka kaunsa?
blocks.explanation: Tawazun aur jism ki halat: cerebellum. Saans ki raftar: brainstem ka medulla oblongata.

items: Meninges: dura mater, arachnoid, pia mater; arachnoid ke neeche CSF.
Dimagh: cerebrum (hemispheres, corpus callosum, chaar lobes, cortex), brainstem (midbrain, pons, medulla), diencephalon (thalamus, hypothalamus), cerebellum, limbic system; chaar ventricles.
Spinal cord: andar grey matter (H), bahar white matter, central canal.
